div.div: "Bound by threads that no exile can sever."
div.p: Like strings of a harpsichord descending from the void, true loyalty binds two hands around the same hilt. Anyone can pledge fealty during the banquet; only the faithful remain when the world forbids the vow and the road leads into the dark.

Beneath every suit of blackened plate armor beats the oldest story in human memory: the refusal to let fear or forbidden gates sever a sworn devotion. A knight without romance is merely a mercenary; it is love that turns cold steel into a sacred calling.

g.text: LOYALTY UNTO DEATH : HONOR BEFORE CROWNS
